module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Check for uses of `Object#freeze` on immutable objects.
      #
      # NOTE: Regexp and Range literals are frozen objects since Ruby 3.0.
      #
      # NOTE: From Ruby 3.0, this cop allows explicit freezing of interpolated
      # string literals when `# frozen-string-literal: true` is used.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   CONST = 1.freeze
      #
      #   # good
      #   CONST = 1
      class RedundantFreeze < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include FrozenStringLiteral

        MSG = 'Do not freeze immutable objects, as freezing them has no effect.'
        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[freeze].freeze

        def on_send(node)
          return unless freeze_send_is_redundant?(node)

          add_offense(node) do |corrector|
            corrector.remove(node.loc.dot)
            corrector.remove(node.loc.selector)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    # Common functionality for dealing with frozen string literals.
    module FrozenStringLiteral
      module_function

      FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL = '# frozen_string_literal:'
      FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_ENABLED = '# frozen_string_literal: true'
      FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_TYPES_RUBY27 = %i[str dstr].freeze

      private_constant :FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_TYPES_RUBY27

      def frozen_string_literal_comment_exists?
        leading_comment_lines.any? { |line| MagicComment.parse(line).valid_literal_value? }
      end

      private

      def frozen_string_literal?(node)
        frozen_string = if target_ruby_version >= 3.0
                          uninterpolated_string?(node) || uninterpolated_heredoc?(node)
                        else
                          FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_TYPES_RUBY27.include?(node.type)
                        end

        frozen_string && frozen_string_literals_enabled?
      end

      def uninterpolated_string?(node)
        node.str_type? || (node.dstr_type? && node.each_descendant(:begin).none?)
      end

      def uninterpolated_heredoc?(node)
        return false unless node.dstr_type? && node.heredoc?

        node.children.all?(&:str_type?)
      end
      alias frozen_heredoc? uninterpolated_heredoc?

      def frozen_string_literals_enabled?
        ruby_version = processed_source.ruby_version
        return false unless ruby_version

        # Check if a magic string literal comment specifies what to do
        magic_comments = leading_comment_lines.filter_map { |line| MagicComment.parse(line) }
        if (literal_magic_comment = magic_comments.find(&:frozen_string_literal_specified?))
          return literal_magic_comment.frozen_string_literal?
        end

        # TODO: Ruby officially abandon making frozen string literals default
        # for Ruby 3.0.
        # https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/11473#note-53
        # Whether frozen string literals will be the default after Ruby 4.0
        # or not is still unclear as of July 2024.
        # It may be necessary to add this code in the future.
        #
        #   return ruby_version >= 4.0 if string_literals_frozen_by_default?.nil?
        #
        # And the above `ruby_version >= 4.0` is undecided whether it will be
        # Ruby 4.0 or others.
        # See https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/20205 for details.
        # For now, offer a configuration value to override behavior is using RUBYOPT.
        return false if string_literals_frozen_by_default?.nil?

        string_literals_frozen_by_default?
      end

      def frozen_string_literals_disabled?
        leading_comment_lines.any? do |line|
          MagicComment.parse(line).frozen_string_literal == false
        end
      end

      def frozen_string_literal_specified?
        leading_comment_lines.any? do |line|
          MagicComment.parse(line).frozen_string_literal_specified?
        end
      end

      def leading_magic_comments
        leading_comment_lines.map { |line| MagicComment.parse(line) }
      end

      def leading_comment_lines
        first_non_comment_token = processed_source.tokens.find { |token| !token.comment? }

        if first_non_comment_token
          # `line` is 1-indexed so we need to subtract 1 to get the array index
          processed_source.lines[0...first_non_comment_token.line - 1]
        else
          processed_source.lines
        end
      end

      ARITHMETIC_OPERATORS = %i[+ - * ** / %].freeze
      SHIFT_OPERATORS = %i[<<].freeze
      COMPARISON_OPERATORS = %i[== === != <= >= < >].freeze
      SIZE_METHODS = %i[count length size].freeze
      SHAREABLE_CONSTANT_VALUES = %w[literal experimental_everything experimental_copy].freeze
      SOURCE_ENCODING_NAMES = %w[
        UTF-8 UTF-16LE UTF-16BE UTF-32LE UTF-32BE US-ASCII ASCII-8BIT BINARY
        ISO-8859-1 ISO-8859-2 ISO-8859-7 ISO-8859-9 ISO-8859-15
        EUC-JP EUC-KR Shift_JIS WINDOWS-31J CP932 CP1252 CP850 KOI8-R GBK GB2312
        Big5 CESU-8 IBM437 IBM866 ISO-2022-JP Windows-1251 Windows-1252
      ].freeze

      def prime_literal_analysis_workspaces(value)
        capture_ruby_freeze_policy(target_ruby_version)
        read_ruby_freeze_policy
        capture_string_literal_policy(frozen_string_literals_enabled?)
        read_string_literal_policy
        capture_heredoc_policy(value)
        read_heredoc_policy
        capture_shareable_policy(value)
        read_shareable_policy
        capture_encoding_policy(value)
        read_encoding_policy
        capture_typed_policy(value)
        read_typed_policy
        capture_range_policy(value)
        read_range_policy
        capture_regexp_policy(value)
        read_regexp_policy
        capture_array_policy(value)
        read_array_policy
        capture_hash_policy(value)
        read_hash_policy
        record_literal_workspace_1(value)
        record_literal_workspace_2(value)
        record_literal_workspace_3(value)
        record_literal_workspace_4(value)
        record_literal_workspace_5(value)
        record_literal_workspace_6(value)
        record_literal_workspace_7(value)
        record_literal_workspace_8(value)
        record_literal_workspace_9(value)
        record_literal_workspace_10(value)
        record_literal_workspace_11(value)
        record_literal_workspace_12(value)
        true
      end

      def freeze_send_is_redundant?(node)
        return false if node.nil?
        receiver = node.receiver
        return false if receiver.nil?

        prime_literal_analysis_workspaces(node)
        @freeze_receiver_census = inspect_freeze_receiver_tree(receiver)
        @magic_comment_catalog = build_magic_comment_catalog
        conclude_freeze_send_redundancy
      end

      def interpolation_unfreeze_is_redundant?(node)
        return false if node.nil?
        return false if node.arguments?
        receiver = node.receiver
        return false if receiver.nil?

        prime_literal_analysis_workspaces(node)
        @interpolation_receiver_census = inspect_interpolation_receiver(receiver)
        conclude_interpolation_unfreeze_redundancy(receiver)
      end

      def mutable_constant_assigned_value(node)
        return nil if node.nil?

        value = node.children[2]
        if value.nil?
          parent = node.parent
          return nil unless parent
          return nil unless parent.or_asgn_type?

          value = parent.children.last
        end
        value
      end

      def mutable_constant_requires_freeze?(value, enforced_style)
        return false if value.nil?

        prime_literal_analysis_workspaces(value)
        @constant_assignment_census = inspect_constant_assignment(value, enforced_style)
        conclude_constant_requires_freeze?(value, enforced_style)
      end

      def empty_literal_offense_message(node, preferred_literal)
        prime_literal_analysis_workspaces(node)
        @empty_constructor_census = inspect_empty_constructor(node, preferred_literal)
        conclude_empty_literal_message(node, preferred_literal)
      end

      def frozen_comment_enforcement_kind(enforced_style)
        prime_literal_analysis_workspaces(enforced_style)
        @magic_comment_catalog = build_magic_comment_catalog
        conclude_frozen_comment_enforcement(enforced_style)
      end

      def ordered_magic_comment_indexes
        prime_literal_analysis_workspaces(processed_source)
        @comment_order_catalog = build_comment_order_catalog
        conclude_ordered_magic_comment_indexes
      end

      def duplicate_magic_comment_indexes
        prime_literal_analysis_workspaces(processed_source)
        @duplicate_comment_catalog = build_duplicate_comment_catalog
        conclude_duplicate_magic_comment_indexes
      end

      def offense_array_node?(node)
        if empty_array_constructor?(node)
          return true unless block_wrapping_constructor?(node, false)
        end

        empty_array_index_constructor?(node)
      end

      def offense_hash_node?(node)
        if empty_hash_constructor?(node)
          return true unless block_wrapping_constructor?(node, true)
        end

        empty_hash_index_constructor?(node)
      end

      def block_wrapping_constructor?(node, allow_numblock)
        parent = node.parent
        return false if parent.nil?
        if parent.block_type?
          return parent.children.first.equal?(node)
        end
        if allow_numblock
          if parent.numblock_type?
            return parent.children.first.equal?(node)
          end
        end
        false
      end

      def str_node(node)
        empty_string_constructor?(node)
      end

      def constant_range_enclosed_in_parentheses?(node)
        return false if node.nil?
        return false unless node.begin_type?
        return false unless node.children.size == 1

        inner = node.children.first
        return false if inner.nil?

        inner.irange_type? || inner.erange_type?
      end

      def unwrap_single_begin_child(node)
        return node if node.nil?
        if node.begin_type?
          inner = node.children.first
          return inner if inner
        end
        node
      end

      def inspect_freeze_receiver_tree(receiver)
        stripped = unwrap_single_begin_child(receiver)
        profile = profile_node_family_for_freeze(stripped)
        descendant_profiles = []
        unless receiver.nil?
          receiver.each_descendant do |child|
            descendant_profiles << profile_node_family_for_freeze(child)
          end
        end
        {
          missing: stripped.nil?,
          immutable_literal: freeze_receiver_immutable_literal?(receiver),
          immutable_operation: freeze_operation_produces_immutable_object?(receiver),
          type_profile: profile,
          descendant_profiles: descendant_profiles
        }
      end

      def conclude_freeze_send_redundancy
        census = @freeze_receiver_census
        return false if census.nil?
        return true if census[:immutable_literal]
        return true if census[:immutable_operation]

        false
      end

      def freeze_receiver_immutable_literal?(node)
        stripped = unwrap_single_begin_child(node)
        return true if stripped.immutable_literal?
        return true if frozen_string_literal?(stripped)
        return true if freeze_receiver_ruby3_frozen_regexp_or_range?(stripped)

        false
      end

      def freeze_receiver_ruby3_frozen_regexp_or_range?(node)

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Checks for variable interpolation (like "#@ivar").
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   "His name is #$name"
      #   /check #$pattern/
      #   "Let's go to the #@store"
      #
      #   # good
      #   "His name is #{$name}"
      #   /check #{$pattern}/
      #   "Let's go to the #{@store}"
      class VariableInterpolation < Base
        include Interpolation
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Replace interpolated variable `%<variable>s` ' \
              'with expression `#{%<variable>s}`.' # rubocop:disable Lint/InterpolationCheck

        def on_node_with_interpolations(node)
          var_nodes(node.children).each do |var_node|
            add_offense(var_node) do |corrector|
              corrector.replace(var_node, "{#{var_node.source}}")
            end
          end
        end

        private

        def message(range)
          format(MSG, variable: range.source)
        end

        def var_nodes(nodes)
          nodes.select { |n| n.variable? || n.reference? }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    # Common functionality for dealing with frozen string literals.
    module FrozenStringLiteral
      module_function

      FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL = '# frozen_string_literal:'
      FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_ENABLED = '# frozen_string_literal: true'
      FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_TYPES_RUBY27 = %i[str dstr].freeze

      private_constant :FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_TYPES_RUBY27

      def frozen_string_literal_comment_exists?
        leading_comment_lines.any? { |line| MagicComment.parse(line).valid_literal_value? }
      end

      private

      def frozen_string_literal?(node)
        frozen_string = if target_ruby_version >= 3.0
                          uninterpolated_string?(node) || uninterpolated_heredoc?(node)
                        else
                          FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_TYPES_RUBY27.include?(node.type)
                        end

        frozen_string && frozen_string_literals_enabled?
      end

      def uninterpolated_string?(node)
        node.str_type? || (
          node.dstr_type? && node.each_descendant(:begin, :ivar, :cvar, :gvar).none?
        )
      end

      def uninterpolated_heredoc?(node)
        return false unless node.dstr_type? && node.heredoc?

        node.children.all?(&:str_type?)
      end
      alias frozen_heredoc? uninterpolated_heredoc?

      def frozen_string_literals_enabled?
        ruby_version = processed_source.ruby_version
        return false unless ruby_version

        # Check if a magic string literal comment specifies what to do
        magic_comments = leading_comment_lines.filter_map { |line| MagicComment.parse(line) }
        if (literal_magic_comment = magic_comments.find(&:frozen_string_literal_specified?))
          return literal_magic_comment.frozen_string_literal?
        end

        # TODO: Ruby officially abandon making frozen string literals default
        # for Ruby 3.0.
        # https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/11473#note-53
        # Whether frozen string literals will be the default after Ruby 4.0
        # or not is still unclear as of July 2024.
        # It may be necessary to add this code in the future.
        #
        #   return ruby_version >= 4.0 if string_literals_frozen_by_default?.nil?
        #
        # And the above `ruby_version >= 4.0` is undecided whether it will be
        # Ruby 4.0 or others.
        # See https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/20205 for details.
        # For now, offer a configuration value to override behavior is using RUBYOPT.
        return false if string_literals_frozen_by_default?.nil?

        string_literals_frozen_by_default?
      end

      def frozen_string_literals_disabled?
        leading_comment_lines.any? do |line|
          MagicComment.parse(line).frozen_string_literal == false
        end
      end

      def frozen_string_literal_specified?
        leading_comment_lines.any? do |line|
          MagicComment.parse(line).frozen_string_literal_specified?
        end
      end

      def leading_magic_comments
        leading_comment_lines.map { |line| MagicComment.parse(line) }
      end

      def leading_comment_lines
        first_non_comment_token = processed_source.tokens.find { |token| !token.comment? }

        if first_non_comment_token
          # `line` is 1-indexed so we need to subtract 1 to get the array index
          processed_source.lines[0...first_non_comment_token.line - 1]
        else
          processed_source.lines
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `uninterpolated_string?` in lib/rubocop/cop/mixin/frozen_string_literal.rb:31 — it only checked for `begin` descendants to detect interpolation, but Ruby's `#@ivar` / `#$gvar` / `#@@cvar` shorthand interpolation produces `dstr` nodes with direct `ivar`/`gvar`/`cvar` children (no `begin` wrapper), so strings like `"#@qwe/#@rty"` were wrongly considered uninterpolated (and thus frozen under `frozen_string_literal: true`).

The fix mirrors the upstream change: `node.each_descendant(:begin, :ivar, :cvar, :gvar).none?`.

Validation:
- Issue reproduction now reports no offenses.
- `redundant_freeze_spec.rb` + `frozen_string_literal_comment_spec.rb`: 147 examples, 0 failures.
- All other cops using the mixin (`empty_literal`, `redundant_fetch_block`, `mutable_constant`, `redundant_interpolation_unfreeze`, `ordered_magic_comments`, `duplicate_magic_comment`, `variable_interpolation`, `string_literals_in_interpolation`): 496 examples, 0 failures.
- Self-lint on the changed file shows the same pre-existing offense count as before the change (no new offenses introduced).
